Aditya — thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: we have SOC 2 Type II in our vendor requirements; a current Redwood SOC 2 Type II report would be ideal. If you can provide a cert + DPA addendum we can fast-track procurement.
- HIPAA / BAA: MedSynth handles PHI; a BAA is required. We’ll need confirmation of encryption at-rest and in-transit, and KMS/HSM usage for keys.
- Retention: for audit logs we require 3 years of retention and searchable access. Backups: our legal/regulatory team prefers a 7-year cold archive for certain records; if you cannot provide 7-year immutable backups, we need a contractual note and deletion exception.
- Deletion: for GDPR erasure requests, we expect primary-data deletion within 30 days. Understandable exceptions for backups; please outline typical backup retention windows and how deletion is handled in restores.

I attached our internal security requirements spreadsheet (MedSynth-Security-Reqs.xlsx) — it lists the specific controls and the fields we’ll flag for the questionnaire.

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and options from Redwood’s side: 

SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report (issued 2025). We can share the report under an NDA; if you’d like immediate access we can provide a bridge letter while the NDA is processed.

BAA / PHI: We support BAAs for customers processing PHI. We use envelope encryption with customer-configurable KMS keys for Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted customers may use Redwood-managed keys unless a dedicated KMS is requested in contract.

Retention / deletion options (summary):
- Hosted Standard: audit/event logs retained 365 days; backups retained 90 days (rolling). Primary data deletion: typically within 30 days from request. Backups: logical deletion occurs within 30 days, but physical removal from cold archives can take up to 90 days depending on provider; we’ll include this in the DPA.
- Hosted Enterprise Add-on: searchable logs retained up to 3 years; cold-archive backups up to 7 years. This is available as a configurable policy with additional storage & egress fees.
- Dedicated / Private: customer-controlled retention windows; we can implement 3y searchable logs + 7y immutable cold archives when deployed into customer VPC or dedicated pools.

Contract language / deletion semantics: we typically include an appendix describing deletion vs restore windows and explicit exceptions for disaster recovery/legal hold. For GDPR erasure requests the primary-data path is deleted within 30 days; backups and cold archives are subject to the backup retention window and we commit to logical scrubbing and eventual physical deletion per the agreed timeline.

Attachments: I’m linking our retention options PDF for your procurement/legal review (attached). Also please complete the vendor questionnaire — the form includes a short section for how you want backups handled so we can bake it into the SOW.

Proposed next steps:
1) Elena: confirm whether MedSynth requires cold-archive immutable backups for the 7-year retention or if an enterprise add-on (searchable logs 3y + 7y archival) is acceptable.
2) Aditya/Ben: prepare two SOW templates (Hosted Enterprise add-on pricing + Dedicated deployment pricing).
3) We’ll provide SOC 2 PDF under NDA — I’ve copied the security ops address to coordinate.

Happy to jump on the Thursday 30-min call. Times that work for me: 10:00-12:00 PDT or 15:00-16:00 PDT.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Compliance | Redwood Inference
